# @vllnt/convex-analytics

> A generic, configurable, embedded analytics component for Convex — any event, any dimension, any domain — with rollup-on-write for reactive aggregate reads. Only unfiltered lifetime metrics use fixed-shard counter reads; other aggregate reads scale with matching rollups. Mount via `app.use()` in any Convex app.

The component owns a standardized, typed schema (events, rollups, subjects, sessions,
scopes, config); host data enters only as opaque refs (`subjectRef`, `sessionRef`) and
host-typed scalar `props` — never `v.any()`. Host-declared `dimensions` drive rollup-on-write;
the verb set (`metric`, `top`, `timeseries`, `uniques`, `funnel`, `retention`, `distribution`,
`list`) is generic, across `minute`/`hour`/`day` granularities. Web
analytics is the opt-in `@vllnt/convex-analytics/web` preset; reactive hooks ship as the
optional `@vllnt/convex-analytics/react` entry. Peer dependency: `convex@^1.45.0`
(`react@>=18` optional for the `./react` entry).

For coding agents: these docs ship inside the npm package at
`node_modules/@vllnt/convex-analytics/docs/` and match the installed version, as do
`src/` and `CHANGELOG.md`. Read them before writing code against this package.

## Docs

- [Quick Start](./docs/quick-start.md): Install, mount, track, read
- [Client SDK](./docs/client-sdk.md): `AnalyticsClient<TProps>` config, verbs, types
- [Schema](./docs/schema.md): events, rollups, subjects, sessions, scopes, config + indexes
- [REST API](./docs/api-reference.md): the five generic routes (/track, /metric, /top, /timeseries, /uniques)
- [Web Preset](./docs/web-preset.md): opt-in web dimensions + UA/geo helpers + React note
- [Multi-Product](./docs/multi-product.md): the opaque `scope` partition
- [Architecture](./docs/architecture.md): rollup-on-write, child components, crons
- [Changelog](./CHANGELOG.md): version history, including unreleased changes
